svg.text: A rhythmic electronic bed, bright synth cues, tempo up on danger and in the bloom. Reads like a score attack.
Evolution · audio direction · build 1 (hooks now, assets later)
First ten minutes of a round (fast solo player, GAME-DESIGN §5.1 pace curve)
100 BPM bed; 120 BPM danger variant while a threat ring is shown; 130 BPM full mix in the bloom; jingle per level-up
bright square-wave blip; pitch climbs a scale step per eat within 1 s (combo), resets on silence
fast upward arpeggio, 0.4 s, quantised to the beat
1.5 s fanfare jingle over the bed; pick = confirm chime
riser + snare roll that tracks progress; hit + sub drop at payout
bed switches to the 120 BPM variant on the next bar; alarm blip every 2 s while the ring shows
short descending "lose a life" stinger; bed drops to drums only for 3 s
power-up sweep upward; full bed returns on the next bar
one-shot zone chime + bed layer change (see zones)
victory jingle (8 s) then a results loop
bed -18 LUFS; cues peak -10 dBFS; eat cooldown 80 ms (combo needs density)
≈ 35–50 sounds per minute; something is always happening
music: 3 tempo variants × 60 s + 10 jingles + results loop ≈ 5 min of generated audio
drums + bass loop, 100 BPM (loop 60 s, bar-aligned)
drums muffled, hi-hats removed, playback rate -10 %
rhythm-reactive arcade (Rez, Sayonara Wild Hearts); Osmos for the drift
Music reacts to the ladder: no
(tempo reacts to danger and the bloom; a lead layer is added at eukaryote only)
